newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand to privatise some state enterprises.
newsitem.headline: Thailand to privatise some state enterprises.

text.p: BANGKOK, March 31 - Thailand's economic ministers on Monday agreed in principle to privatise some state enterprises in an attempt to increase their effectiveness and reduce the government's foreign debt servicing, the finance minister said.

"It's the government's policy to increase (the) private sector's role in some existing state agencies," Amnuay Viravan told reporters. "The government will accelerate the privatisation (of those agencies)."
The privatisation could also improve the quality of state enterprises' services, he said.

Among eight state agencies that the government plans to privatise by reducing its stake in them to less than 50 percent included Thai Airways International Plc, the Telephone Organisation of Thailand, the Communication Authority of Thailand and the Transport Co Ltd, a government statement said.

However, the government would maintain its majority holding in some other agenices involving national security and financial services such as the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand and the Petroleum Authority of Thailand, it added.
